officialTitle: Trastuzumab emtansine for HER2-positive advanced breast cancer
setting: Previously treated advanced/metastatic (after trastuzumab and a taxane)

design.notes: Two interim analyses of overall survival were conducted.

clinicalQuestion: Is the HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate T-DM1 superior to lapatinib plus capecitabine in HER2-positive advanced breast cancer previously treated with trastuzumab and a taxane?

pico.population: HER2-positive advanced breast cancer previously treated with trastuzumab and a taxane
pico.outcomes: Primary: PFS by independent review, OS, safety. Secondary: investigator-assessed PFS, ORR, time to symptom progression

publications.title: Trastuzumab emtansine for HER2-positive advanced breast cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis (second interim OS)

outcomes.sourceQuote: median progression-free survival as assessed by independent review was 9.6 months with T-DM1 versus 6.4 months with lapatinib plus capecitabine (hazard ratio for progression or death from any cause, 0.65; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.55 to 0.77; P<0.001)

median overall survival at the second interim analysis crossed the stopping boundary for efficacy (30.9 months vs. 25.1 months; hazard ratio for death from any cause, 0.68; 95% CI, 0.55 to 0.85; P<0.001)
The objective response rate was higher with T-DM1 (43.6%, vs. 30.8% with lapatinib plus capecitabine; P<0.001)

safety.sourceQuote: Rates of grade 3 or 4 adverse events were higher with lapatinib plus capecitabine than with T-DM1 (57% vs. 41%).

safety.description: Thrombocytopenia and increased aminotransferases more frequent with T-DM1; diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting and palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia more frequent with lapatinib plus capecitabine
safety.sourceQuote: The incidences of thrombocytopenia and increased serum aminotransferase levels were higher with T-DM1, whereas the incidences of diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia were higher with lapatinib plus capecitabine.

strengths: Large randomised phase III trial with PFS by independent review
OS was a co-primary endpoint and crossed the efficacy boundary at interim analysis
limitations: Open-label comparison (not described as blinded in the abstract)
Comparator has since been superseded by newer HER2-directed agents

clinicalImplications.text: Established T-DM1 as a standard option after trastuzumab and a taxane for HER2-positive advanced breast cancer, later used as the comparator for trastuzumab deruxtecan in DESTINY-Breast03.

tumourBoardPearl.text: T-DM1 toxicity is different from lapatinib-capecitabine: check platelets and liver enzymes rather than expecting diarrhoea and hand-foot syndrome.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 23020162. Final OS analysis not yet ingested.
